# Data Engineer — Example Analytics Ltd. (fictional)

Remote within the EU, team based in Lisbon.

## What you will do
- Build and run batch and streaming pipelines that feed our analytics warehouse
- Model data in the warehouse for analysts and data scientists
- Own data quality checks and pipeline monitoring

## Must have
- 3+ years building production data pipelines
- Strong SQL and experience with a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake or Redshift)
- Python for data processing
- Experience with an orchestrator such as Airflow or Dagster
- Understanding of data modelling (star schema, slowly changing dimensions)

## Nice to have
- Spark or Beam for large-scale processing
- dbt
- Infrastructure as code (Terraform)

## Benefits
- Four-day work week trial
- Home office budget
